package main

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/ProtoDurian/diene.go-lib/adapters/kv"
	"github.com/ProtoDurian/diene.go-lib/lib/note"
	"github.com/ProtoDurian/diene.go-lib/testhelper"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	service := note.NewService(testhelper.NewMemoryStore(), note.NewKeyComposer("notes"))
	created, _ := service.Create(ctx, "Deadcode Consumer", "public surface")
	_, _ = service.Load(ctx, created.Slug)
	redis := kv.NewRedisStore("127.0.0.1:6379")
	_ = redis.Save(ctx, created.Slug, created.Body)
	_, _ = redis.Load(ctx, created.Slug)
	_ = redis.Close()
}
